title: Batman: Arkham Origins
provenance: Reported by Bipolaire (highball-db#957, 2026-11-03), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 22 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever (highball-db#978, 2026-11-04), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.25, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 1 of 5 after 2 minutes: freezes at the legal screen at start. The log shows the 32-bit game drawing through DXMT, and the environment wasn't restarted before the launch because another program was still running, so it ran with sync off. The game was on an external drive.
notes: Reported perfect on an M4 Pro with DXMT over 22 minutes on the default engine (r26). On an M1 with engine r29 it froze at the legal screen at start (highball-db#978). It's a 32-bit game.

knownIssues.symptom: Freezes at the legal screen at start (M1, Wine 10 r29, the game drawing through DXMT)
